description: Checks Kaal Sarp, Pitra, Guru Chandal, Grahan and Mangal (Manglik) dosha, with Manglik house details and cancellation conditions. Trikaal Vaani, Swiss Ephemeris.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 28.6139)

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 77.2090)

time.description: Time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM (local time at birthplace). 12:00 is the conventional value when the exact time is unknown.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours at birth (India = 5.5)
